dedupe_keys.name: land use land cover classifications of the cold lake oil sands area derived from 2005 landsat imagery image data tiff format

description: Alberta Geological Survey provides a linked regional series of Landsat-derived land-use/land-cover classifications, annual disturbance and vegetation-recovery classifications, quality masks and compiled anthropogenic-footprint polygons for the Cold Lake oil-sands area. The Cold Lake coverage is Township 56–69, Range 1–11 west of the Fourth Meridian. Nine annual classification titles span 2005–2013; eight disturbance and eight recovery pairs span 2005–2006 through 2012–2013. Seven quality-mask titles cover 2005–2011 and mark possible sensor-noise, cloud, haze or shadow misclassification with value 1. A companion shapefile compiles developed and mixed-developed footprint classes from the 2005–2013 classifications. The source explicitly defines these data as baselines for planning and monitoring surface infrastructure needs and impacts. Cold Lake class codes differ from the pilot-area series and include a fire-scar class. Disturbance and recovery include oil/gas infrastructure effects alongside forestry and agriculture; they are not inventories of energy assets alone. TIFF-labelled products are linked as ZIP archives, and the footprint product is described as polygon GIS data. Only HTML/XML metadata routes are listed for the compiled footprint, so its payload route remains unresolved. Numerical contents, projection, pixel size, accuracy and cross-year comparability were not checked. The source states Open Government Licence - Alberta and unrestricted access, while the catalogue machine flag isopen is false. Those fields are preserved without assuming the machine flag overrides the named licence. Metadata was inspected; no archive, image or GIS payload was fetched. Present distribution access and cost remain unverified.
